title: Saved information.
description: Review what's kept and choose what happens next.
sessionNotice: These are separate, preloaded fictional examples for this session. They are not your connected-watch data or summaries generated from conversations. Reloading or restarting restores the examples.
available: Fictional information available for this session.
unavailable: No information kept in this category for this session.
noSelection: Select at least one available category to export or delete.
empty: No demo information remains in this session.
deleteDescription: Only the categories listed below will be removed from this session. The weekly summary is an independent snapshot: deleting wellness records keeps it unless you also select it. Reloading or restarting restores the fictional examples.
deleteScope: This does not delete conversations, emotion observations, remembered details, connected-watch records, contacts, privacy preferences, or previously confirmed share snapshots.
deleted: Selected demo information removed from this session.
exportDescription: Review the saved demo categories you selected.
exportNotice: Demo export preview only. No file export, download, sending, or sharing service is connected. This preview does not create a Shared Information record.
invalidSelection: The selected demo information is missing or no longer available. Return to Saved information and choose available categories.
exportDone: Simulation complete. No information was sent and no file was downloaded.
